# A7.01 Test plan creation

## Owner
A7

## Stage
Verify

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
—

## Input (reads)
Stories, acceptance criteria, risks, environments

## Steps
1. List the scope from stories.
2. List test types per story.
3. List environments and data.
4. List risks

## Output (writes)
Test plan

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/tests/test-plan-<ID>.md`

## Verification
Every acceptance criterion is in scope

## Checkpoints raised
- none
